senses.gloss: f. (יָרַד) leading down, letting down; descent.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:6:5">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ</cite> top <he>משעת ה׳</he> from the moment the calf is led down (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:4">Deut. XXI, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:7">Midd. IV, 7</cite> <he>בית הוֹרָדַת המים</he> (Talm. ed. <he>הוֹרְדוֹת</he> pl.) an enclosure in the Temple serving as a spout for the rain water.
